relative_alpha_source: independent D_fit unselected conditional eligible-scene risk
inner_split: existing deterministic m069 D_cal fit/calib hash
fallback_unit: tile/image when frozen roles overlap at mother-scene level
eligible_universe: original scenes with at least one eligible ar>=2.1 matched prediction
post_threshold_empty_scene: abstained; excluded from conditional risk and retained in nonempty-rate denominator
score_direction: larger is more reliable; frozen before calibration
missing_tta_policy: rank after all finite TTA scores; eligible universe unchanged; disclose rate
ltt: fixed sequence from lowest to highest target coverage; stop rejecting after first calibration failure
trivial_rule: alpha >= D_fit unselected conditional scene base risk
infeasible_rule: no certified nonzero selection on frozen grid or nonempty scene rate=0
